description: Defines the CUDAPluggableAllocator class and related functions for custom CUDA memory allocation in PyTorch, including allocator management, stream recording, and pool handling.

classes.name: _AllocationMetadata
classes.description: Holds metadata about individual memory allocations, including size, device index, and stream.

classes.name: CUDAPluggableAllocator
classes.description: A custom CUDA memory allocator class that extends the CUDACachingAllocator, allowing user-defined allocation and deallocation functions, stream recording, and pool management.

methods.name: getCurrentAllocator
methods.description: Returns the current CUDA allocator instance.

methods.name: createCustomAllocator
methods.description: Creates a new custom CUDA allocator with user-defined alloc and free functions.

methods.name: changeCurrentAllocator
methods.description: Sets the current CUDA allocator to the specified one.

methods.name: set_init_fn
methods.description: Sets the initialization function for the allocator.

methods.name: set_reset_fn
methods.description: Sets the reset function for the allocator.

methods.name: set_memory_fraction_fn
methods.description: Sets the function to control memory fraction.

methods.name: set_base_alloc_fn
methods.description: Sets the base allocation function.

methods.name: set_record_stream_fn
methods.description: Sets the function to record stream information.

methods.name: set_begin_allocate_to_pool
methods.description: Sets the callback for beginning allocation to a pool.

methods.name: set_end_allocate_to_pool_fn
methods.description: Sets the callback for ending allocation to a pool.

methods.name: set_release_pool
methods.description: Sets the callback for releasing a memory pool.

methods.name: malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory of specified size on a given device and stream.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates device memory and returns a DataPtr.

methods.name: raw_deleter
methods.description: Returns the deleter function for raw memory.

methods.name: raw_alloc
methods.description: Allocates raw memory.

methods.name: raw_alloc_with_stream
methods.description: Allocates raw memory with a specific stream.

methods.name: raw_delete
methods.description: Deletes raw memory.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the allocator for a given number of devices.

methods.name: initialized
methods.description: Checks if the allocator is initialized.

methods.name: getMemoryFraction
methods.description: Returns the memory fraction for a device.

methods.name: setMemoryFraction
methods.description: Sets the memory fraction for a device.

methods.name: getExpandableSegmentSizes
methods.description: Returns segment sizes that can be expanded.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Empties the cache for a memory pool.

methods.name: cacheInfo
methods.description: Provides cache information including largest block.

methods.name: getBaseAllocation
methods.description: Retrieves base allocation info for a pointer.

methods.name: recordStream
methods.description: Records stream information for a data pointer.

methods.name: getDeviceStats
methods.description: Returns device statistics.

methods.name: resetAccumulatedStats
methods.description: Resets accumulated stats.

methods.name: resetPeakStats
methods.description: Resets peak stats.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the allocator state.

methods.name: beginAllocateToPool
methods.description: Begins allocation to a memory pool.

methods.name: endAllocateToPool
methods.description: Ends allocation to a memory pool.

methods.name: releasePool
methods.description: Releases a memory pool.

methods.name: getIpcDevPtr
methods.description: Gets an IPC device pointer from a handle.

methods.name: shareIpcHandle
methods.description: Shares an IPC handle for a pointer.

methods.name: recordHistory
methods.description: Records allocation history.

methods.name: attachOutOfMemoryObserver
methods.description: Attaches an OOM observer.

methods.name: attachAllocatorTraceTracker
methods.description: Attaches an allocator trace tracker.

methods.name: getCheckpointState
methods.description: Gets checkpoint state for a device.

methods.name: setCheckpointPoolState
methods.description: Sets checkpoint pool state.

methods.name: enablePeerAccess
methods.description: Enables peer access between devices.

methods.name: memcpyAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous memory copy.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the name of the allocator.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Copies data between memory locations.
